description_en: Queries the security token information of a namespace. You can call this operation to query information, such as the AccessKey ID, AccessKey secret, tenant ID, and the domain name of Address Server, for the specified namespace
description_zh: 调用GetSecureToken获取指定命名空间的SecureToken信息，主要是用来获取指定命名空间的AccessKey ID、AccessKey Secret 、TenantId、地址服务器域名等信息
name: GetSecureToken
